answer: Trust flows like cold meltwater carving an ancient glacier; consensus solidifies only through deep, accumulated proof-of-interaction. Sybil swarms spawn hollow clones to flood the network, but validator weight behaves like a sheltered lagoon: past performance deposits dense sediment, while spawning unverified nodes demands superlinear staking collateral. Because validation costs scale superlinearly, synthetic identities freeze out before diluting authentic consensus.
